subject: Coordinating Javier Rivera's half-day loop — staggered panels & backup coverage
messages:
From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Javier Rivera <j.rivera@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed half-day loop for Javier Rivera (SWE II) — Wed 4/7 or Thu 4/8

Hi all —

Following up on Javier (candidate) — he’s excited about the loop and has asked for a condensed half-day virtual onsite. Candidate is in EST. Initial availability from Calendly shows two windows we can fit into:

- Wed 7 Apr: 10:00–14:30 ET (preferred)
- Thu 8 Apr: 12:00–16:30 ET (backup)

Quick ask: can we create a staggered panel so he has one deep technical interview, one system-design, one product/pm-style conversation, plus a short hiring manager debrief and a 30-min break before the final cultural/values conversation?

I’ve attached his resume and the Calendly export. If you have absolute constraints please reply with times you cannot cover. I can own candidate comms and calendar sends once we agree the order.

Attachments: J_Rivera_Resume.pdf (pdf), candidate_availability.csv (csv)

Thanks —
Dylan
Sr. Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference
From: Javier Rivera <j.rivera@gmail.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 12:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposed half-day loop for Javier Rivera (SWE II) — Wed 4/7 or Thu 4/8

Hi Dylan —

Thanks — Wed 4/7 is best for me (EST). I can do the morning block, but I’ll need a 30-minute break between interviews around noon (I have a prior commitment). Also remote is fine; I won’t need anything special.

One ask — can we keep the total interview time under 4 hours? I prefer the deep technical interview earlier while I’m fresh.

Appreciate it,
Javier

Subject: Re: Proposed half-day loop for Javier Rivera (SWE II) — Wed 4/7 or Thu 4/8

Thanks, Dylan and Javier.

Team — Javier prefers Wed 4/7 morning and needs a 30-min break around 12:00 ET. My proposal for a staggered half-day (all virtual) using ET times:

1) 10:00–10:50 ET — Technical deep dive (coding) — 50m (owner: markus_klein)
2) 11:00–11:30 ET — System design overview (30m) — 30m (owner: laura_bennett)
3) 11:35–12:05 ET — Product/PM-style convo (30m) — 30m (owner: stephanie_nguyen)
4) 12:05–12:35 ET — 30-min break for candidate
5) 12:35–13:05 ET — Hiring manager debrief + role Qs (30m) — 30m (owner: kimberly_park)
6) 13:10–13:40 ET — Culture/values & close (30m) — 30m (owner: laura_bennett)

Total time on calendar: ~3.75 hours including breaks/transition buffers.

Coverage notes: please confirm if you can take the exact slots above. If anyone has a hard block at those ET times, propose a swap rather than declining — we should avoid moving the candidate if possible.

I’ll prepare a one-page agenda and an .ics invite once we lock the order. Dylan — I’ll need the resume + any redlines you want to surface to interviewers.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

Kim — that order looks good. Two small asks:

- Can we flip system-design and product convo? I can stay for product at 11:35 if it helps the flow (I’ll be able to pivot quickly after coding).
- I’ll need a 5-min buffer at the end of my coding slot to jot notes and hand off context to Laura. Can we add a calendar buffer 10:50–10:55 ET?

If that works, I’m confirmed for Wed 4/7.

-Markus
Staff SWE
Redwood Inference

Hi Javier + team —

Thanks for the quick responses. Attached is the finalized one-page agenda and I built the calendar block with staggered interviews and a short buffer between interviews per Markus’s note. Summary (ET):

- 10:00–10:50 — Technical deep dive (Markus Klein)
- 10:50–10:55 — Buffer for notes/hand-off
- 11:00–11:30 — Product conversation (Laura Bennett)
- 11:35–12:05 — System design (Stephanie Nguyen)
- 12:05–12:35 — Candidate break
- 12:35–13:05 — Hiring manager Qs / role fit (Kimberly Park)
- 13:10–13:40 — Culture & close (Laura Bennett)

Attachments: full_loop_agenda.pdf, candidate_halfday.ics, J_Rivera_Resume.pdf

Javier — the calendar invite has been sent from our scheduling system (link below). Please accept and let us know immediately if the 12:05–12:35 break is problematic. We’ll keep each interview focused and respect the 30-min break you requested.

Link to invite: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/abc123

-Kim
